title: CLAIM: The Finders were a CIA child-trafficking front
summary: Claims allege a CIA-front child-trafficking/satanic cult whose investigation was shut down as a 'CIA internal matter.' The 324-page FBI file shows the 1987 investigation found no evidence of criminal activity; charges were dropped; no convictions. The CIA-interference claim exists in the file only as an allegation in one Customs memo; the 1993–94 DOJ review did not substantiate it.
tldr: The claim that the Finders were a CIA child-trafficking front shut down as a 'CIA internal matter' is unproven: the 324-page FBI file shows the investigation found no criminal activity, and the CIA-interference allegation appears only once, unsubstantiated, in a Customs memo.
ai_summary:
AI review of the FBI Vault Finders index and the wave-2 research review of the file:
- The 'CIA internal matter' shutdown narrative traces to a single 1987 U.S. Customs memo within the file — an allegation, not a finding.
- The 1993-94 DOJ review of the case did not substantiate CIA interference.
- The 1987 investigation itself (Tallahassee/DC) found no evidence of criminal activity; charges dropped; zero convictions.
- No primary source in the released file supports a CIA-front child-trafficking operation. Record's UNPROVEN status verified appropriate.
